name: EPIC 220449405
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 13.0 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220449405 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 12.983963 (16th-84th percentiles 12.518682-13.411314), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 5,520 parsecs away, 13 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.90 solar masses and 13.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,720 K at its surface.
